source_text: In contrast, voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs, promoted by organizations like WHO since 2007, involve trained surgeons in clinical settings with anesthesia and post-operative care, yielding complication rates below 2% and emphasizing HIV prevention through a demonstrated 50-60% reduction in heterosexual transmission risk.
